facts.fact: ONPF director general Imed Hammadi said remote services are already available, including consulting land titles, certified copies, ownership certificates and searches on a person's properties.

Hammadi said several remote ONPF services are already available, including consulting land titles, certified copies and land registration certificates, with a second digitalisation phase aiming for a paperless administration within three years.
